summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K clarifying media speculation, not a transactional event. Responding to an October 13, 2026 Electronic Times article titled 'SK Telecom Seeks 5GW Overseas AI Data Center Expansion for Asian Hub,' the Korean registrant states no specific plans exist for securing an additional 5 GW of overseas AIDC capacity. It references its June 30, 2026 fair-disclosure filing outlining a phased 15 GW mid- to long-term AIDC buildout. No price, stake, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are disclosed. No deal terms, no regulatory clock; watch for follow-on 6-Ks on AIDC financing or partnerships.
